A machine spits out random 1s and 0s - literally a coin flip, coded. Run it a billion times and it lands right at 49.9% to 50.1%. Never quite 50/50, but close.

Then researchers sat someone in front of it and told them: think '1' more than '0.'

The next run wasn't 50.1%. It was 51%, 52% - far enough outside the normal range that researchers called it a complete anomaly. They repeated it over and over. Every single time, whatever a person quietly wanted more of, the random machine gave them more of.

Kevin Trudeau calls it empirical evidence: thought can shift a random outcome.

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #lawofattraction #mindset #scienceofluck #personalgrowth

Researchers - Kevin Trudeau says this came from the US Army - took DNA out of a person's body and put it in a petri dish.

They showed the person violent images. The DNA in their body contracted. So did the DNA in the separate petri dish, not physically connected to anything.

So they moved the dish further away - eventually the other side of the planet, sealed in a lead-lined room that blocks every signal. Same result. The instant the person saw something disturbing, the DNA contracted, no delay. Positive images, and it expanded, instantly, oceans away.

Your mind changes reality, he says - not metaphorically. Measurably.

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #lawofattraction #mindset #quantumfield #scienceofluck

In this particular meeting there was a raffle. Maybe a hundred kids, one ticket each, three prizes.

A young Kevin Trudeau decided he was going to win - and instead of just hoping, he put himself into a specific mental state and held the image of winning, with total certainty, before a single name was called.

First prize: not him. Second prize: not him. He stood up and started walking toward the stage before the third name was even drawn.

They called it: Kevin Trudeau. "I said right here. I knew that was my name. I saw it so clear."

That was the moment he says he knew you can change your luck.

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #lawofattraction #mindset #scienceofluck #personalgrowth

Kevin Trudeau walks into the high-limit slot machines in Vegas with $500 coins and pulls five or six machines in a row before any of them finish spinning.

Every single one hits. $30,000. $2,500. $1,000. His friends' eyes go wide.

They collect the money and start walking through the casino - when a guard with a gun comes running, yelling "sir, sir." His stomach drops. Did they do something wrong?

"You still have a credit in one of the machines," the guard says. He'd forgotten to pull one. They walk back. He pulls it.

$150,000. He hands it all to his friends on the spot. "That's luck," he says. "No skill involved."

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #lawofattraction #mindset #scienceofluck #wealthmindset

Larry King once asked Bill Gates, live on CNN, what the secret to his success was.

Gates - at the time one of the richest men alive - said number one: he was at the right place at the right time, and luck had a lot to do with it.

Kevin Trudeau calls that moment "stop the presses": the richest man in the world, on live television, crediting luck first.

But Gates didn't stop there. Plenty of other people were standing in that exact same room, at that exact same moment, just as lucky. The difference, he said, was that he actually saw the potential in software and home computing. They didn't.

Luck gets you in the room. Vision is what you do once you're there.

#kevintrudeau #wealthmindset #mindset #billgates #scienceofluck #successhabits

Kevin Trudeau, in his twenties, met the past president of Tandy Corporation - the company that owned Radio Shack - in a hotel bar in Denver.

He asked the obvious question: what's the secret to success? The man said the same thing Bill Gates would say on live TV years later - right place, right time, luck has a lot to do with it. But then he added something else: you have to have "depth of vision."

He picked up a box of matches from the bar. "Imagine this is an acorn," he said. "What do you see?" Kevin said a tree.

"I see a forest," the man said. One acorn leads to a tree. A tree leads to a forest.

#kevintrudeau #wealthmindset #mindset #successhabits #scienceofluck #visionary

Kevin Trudeau says you don't need to be right 100% of the time to get rich. You don't even need 51%.

You need to be right once.

Two horses cross the finish line. One wins by a nose - an inch, maybe a centimeter. The winner doesn't get paid double. He gets paid 50 times more than the horse that came in second, even though he didn't run 50 times faster.

That tiny edge is the whole game. Luck, in Kevin Trudeau's math, isn't about being right more often. It's about shifting the outcome just enough, just once, at the moment it counts.

What's the one small edge you've been ignoring?
